content: Create a parody song about working from home during the pandemic.

Verse 1:
I used to commute and get dressed up
But now I wake up and pour a cup
Of coffee, sit down in my chair
And start a day of Zoom despair

Chorus:
'Cause we're working from home, oh yeah
In our sweatpants, without a care
No more office drama or commute
We can work in our birthday suit

Verse 2:
I don't miss those water cooler chats
Or the loud coworkers who yap and chat
I'm in control of my workspace
And there's no boss looking over my face

Chorus:
'Cause we're working from home, oh yeah
In our sweatpants, without a care
No more office drama or commute
We can work in our birthday suit

Bridge:
But it's not all fun and games
With kids and pets disrupting our space
We've got to stay focused and work hard
From our makeshift office in the yard

Chorus:
'Cause we're working from home, oh yeah
In our sweatpants, without a care
No more office drama or commute
We can work in our birthday suit

Outro:
Working from home during the pandemic
It's a new way of life, let's all embrace it
We'll get through this together, no doubt
One day we'll all be back in the office, no shout!
That's a great start, but can you add some humor to the lyrics? Maybe make a reference to the endless snacking that happens while working from home?
